{{Quote|I made this for you. So you'd remember me. I carved it out of a japor snippet. It'll bring you good fortune.|Anakin Skywalker giving the japor snippet to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Japor snippets''' were small wood jewels carved by youngsters on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and used for good luck or as love charms. They were usually made from shell halves of [[Japor tree]] nuts,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and less frequently from [[Japor ivory wood]],<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary" /> and carved with tribal runes.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
A good-luck-charm japor snippet was given as a gift to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] while they were traveling to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aboard the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" /> Carved as traditional [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sand symbols from a piece of japor ivory wood Skywalker acquired through trading, it was threaded with a string of [[Jerba/Legends|jerba]] [[Leather/Legends|leather]].<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary" />

[[File:JaporSnippet-CW21.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The japor snippet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
[[19 BBY/Legends|Thirteen years after]] Skywalker gifted it to her, Amidala still had the japor snippet in her possession, kept in a box along with Skywalker's [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]].<ref name="CW21">{{CW|21}}</ref> She privately wore it whenever she was with her [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|husband]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> While she lay dying following Skywalker's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and after giving birth to their children, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], Amidala gave the japor snippet to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Skywalker's former Master and the future Master of her son,<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> to keep for her. However, Kenobi did not understand the significance of her gesture, only understanding Amidala's basic feelings about it, and returned it to her.<ref name="ROTS novel" /> After her [[Death/Legends|death]], Amidala's body held the japor snippet during her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral procession]],<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" /> and was [[Burial/Legends|buried]] alongside her body<ref name="TCSWE" /> in a [[Tomb of Padmé Amidala/Legends|privately owned mausoleum]].<ref name="Mourning for Padmé">{{Topps|set=2012 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 7|cardname=Mourning for Padmé}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a band of criminals stole all the stock of japor snippet necklaces and the carving tools from a japor carver on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:JT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Japor Thieves}}</ref>
